title: Sausages with Creamy Mash and Onion Gravy
summary: A classic British dinner of browned sausages, buttery mashed potatoes, and a rich onion gravy. Comforting, savoury, and ideal for a simple weeknight meal.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Put the sausages on a baking tray and bake for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, put the potatoes in a pan of salted water, bring to the boil, and cook for 15–20 minutes until very tender.
While the potatoes cook, heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the onions with a pinch of salt and cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring often, until soft and golden.

Stir the flour and thyme into the onions and cook for 1 minute. Gradually add the vegetable stock, stirring well until smooth, then simmer for 4–5 minutes until thickened. Season with black pepper and a little more salt if needed.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with the butter and milk until smooth and creamy. Season to taste.
Serve the sausages over the mash with the onion gravy spooned over the top.
